page: Vultr voc-s-8c-64gb-1280s-amd is an Optimized Cloud Compute server powered by an AMD EPYC x86_64 processor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with 2 threads per core, operating at a base clock speed of 2.0 GHz. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. Local storage consists of a bundled 1280 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark results indicate strong single-core performance, with stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores placing in the top 25%. Text processing tasks also perform in the upper-tier category. Multi-core performance, including stress-ng multi-core and Geekbench multi-core metrics, falls within the average range. Memory performance is robust, highlighted by a strong PassMark memory score, while uncached memory bandwidth reads reach up to 127.29 GB/sec and writes reach 75.3 GB/sec.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and the bundled 1280 GB NVMe SSD, this server is well-suited for memory-intensive workloads, database operations, and caching layers like Redis, which achieved 15.7 million operations per second in testing. It is also capable of handling static web serving and software compilation. However, it exhibits weaker performance in complex tasks such as prompt processing for medium-sized 7B LLM models, and lacks GPU acceleration, making it less suitable for heavy machine learning training or large-scale AI inference.
